title: Bhai Karna Hai Chehlum
body:
*Hayeee*
*Qabre sarwar Jio aaeye Nazar*
*Phoot ker roeye khasta jigar*
*Di Sada Aey ghareebul watan*
*Mil gaeye hai rihaiye magar*
*Mere bhaiyya Amanat teri*
*Qaid khane mein hi reh gaeye*
*Mein ne koshish bahut ki magar*
*Ho gaya khatm uska safar*
*Haye afsos do saal se*
*Rona paeye mein khul ke tujhe*
*Aaj karna hai matam mujhe*
*mere bhaiyya teri qabr per*
*Karrahi thi Ye zainab buka Bhai karna hai chehlum tera*
*Aa gaeye hai bahen karbala Bhai Karna hai chehlum tera*
Umme laila hai sajjad hai Amma fizza bhi ab saath hai (2)
Leke aaeye hun ik qafila Bhai Karna hai chehlum Tera
*Karrahi thi Ye zainab buka Bhai karna hai chehlum tera*
*Aa gaeye hai bahen karbala Bhai Karna hai chehlum tera*
Qaid se jab rihaiye mili Mar chuki thi Sakeena teri (2)
Saath laeye hun uski rida
Bhai Karna hai chehlum tera
*Karrahi thi Ye zainab buka Bhai karna hai chehlum tera*
*Aa gaeye hai bahen karbala Bhai Karna hai chehlum tera*
Shaam ki auratain ro padin bhar gaeye ansoowon se Zamee'n (2)
Ik Bahen ne Jo rokar kaha Bhai Karna hai chehlum tera
*Karrahi thi Ye zainab buka Bhai karna hai chehlum tera*
*Aa gaeye hai bahen karbala Bhai Karna hai chehlum tera*
Qabre Sarwar pa Pehle giri phir Ye boli bahen aagaeye (2)
Le Salam apni humsheer ka Bhai Karna hai chehlum tera
*Karrahi thi Ye zainab buka Bhai karna hai chehlum tera*
*Aa gaeye hai bahen karbala Bhai Karna hai chehlum tera*
Akbar o Aun ko rou'ngi qasim o joun ko rou'ngi (2)
Aaj roeygi khud karbala Bhai Karna hai chehlum tera
*Karrahi thi Ye zainab buka Bhai karna hai chehlum tera*
*Aa gaeye hai bahen karbala Bhai Karna hai chehlum tera*
Umme kulsoom ka tha Baya'n Bhai abbas tum ho kaha'n (2)
Haq tumhara karu'ngi ada Bhai Karna hai chehlum tera
*Karrahi thi Ye zainab buka Bhai karna hai chehlum tera*
*Aa gaeye hai bahen karbala Bhai Karna hai chehlum tera*
Jab yahan se watan jaou'ngi ghar se pehle haram jaou'ngi (2)
Pehle matam karu'ngi bapa Bhai Karna hai chehlum tera
*Karrahi thi Ye zainab buka Bhai karna hai chehlum tera*
*Aa gaeye hai bahen karbala Bhai Karna hai chehlum tera*
Qabre ahmed pa pehladiya Khoo'n bhara pairahan bhai ka (2)
Phir ye zainab ne rokar kaha Bhai Karna hai chehlum tera
*Karrahi thi Ye zainab buka Bhai karna hai chehlum tera*
*Aa gaeye hai bahen karbala Bhai Karna hai chehlum tera*
Noha padhta hai Salman ka jab bhi shozab ba aah o buka (2)
Aati hai ik bahen ki Sada Bhai Karna hai chehlum tera
*Karrahi thi Ye zainab buka Bhai karna hai chehlum tera*
*Aa gaeye hai bahen karbala Bhai Karna hai chehlum tera*
